The first part — phase 1, the chart builder and saved views — opens to customers in a design-partner beta on Wednesday Dec 9, for five customers: Orbitly, Zest Grocers, and three accounts from the October trial cohort [6][10]. Everyone else waits for general availability, targeted for late January and not committed [6].

The Oct 26 spec only said early December with the exact date still TBD [1]. The Nov 12 sync said phase 1 should be feature-complete behind the flag by Dec 4, with the beta right after [5]. The Dec 9 date is the later, more specific plan [6].
